name: MuRF (Multi-Baseline Radiance Fields)
definition: A general feed-forward approach to solving sparse view synthesis under multiple different baseline settings (small and large baselines, and different number of input views). It discretizes 3D space into planes parallel to the target image plane to construct a target view frustum volume, spatially aligned with the target view, which aggregates relevant information from input views for high-quality rendering and facilitates radiance field regression with a convolutional network.
